skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply marketing principles in distribution channel management.
Analyze and manage distribution channels, including member activities and channel operations.
Propose strategies and solutions for distribution channel management.
Apply communication skills in marketing and distribution channel management.
Work independently and collaboratively in distribution channel management.
Solve problems related to distribution channel management.
Prepare and deliver presentations on distribution channel management topics.
Conduct research and analyze data related to distribution channel management.
Apply negotiation skills in distribution channel management.
Evaluate and critique distribution channel strategies and operations.
